problem: Public calibration Edge Function records NO_DUE_CALIBRATIONS when its restricted public-scope queue is empty even if company/person calibration obligations are overdue.

observations.source_isolation: Public market calibration selector intentionally permits market, segment, technology, regulation and behavior, not company or person.

root_cause: Whole-system due count is different from the deliberately restricted public LLM selector. The caller reported the narrow zero as a global zero.
corrective_change: On zero public-scope candidates, read only a canonical aggregate count of all due obligations. Preserve the original public-only RPC and scheduler auth, log out_of_public_scope_due and NON_PUBLIC_SCOPE_BACKLOG, and never forward company/person payload to an LLM.
prevention_rule: No agent may mark a global outcome queue empty based on a scope-limited selection. Unsupported due obligations remain OPEN with truthful owner scope; no invented calibration, closure or customer/revenue result.
release_requirement: Exact-head Required, CodeQL and protected merge, provider three-file source parity including shared dependencies, and authenticated real production canary. Until then NOT_LIVE.
